sources.sanitization: Native macOS window captures supplied by the owner on 2026-10-20, taken in --demo mode against the in-memory S3 server; compressed with the PicForge WebP Balanced preset (quality 75, no resize), alpha kept; bucket names are fictional.
observations: 2742x1822 at 2x: the main window with macOS window controls and the system's own shadow on a transparent background, one per theme.
inferences: The page shows the captures without a frame, border or added shadow.
limitations: The transparent margin is not suitable as an Open Graph image; the social preview composes the light capture on an opaque background.

sources.location: README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/cli.md, docs/cli.zh-CN.md, CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md, LICENSE
observations: The docs pages render these files on the site. Get started uses the README sections Install, Quick start, Command line, Build from source, Data and privacy and Platform status, in English and Chinese. The CLI reference and the changelog have Chinese counterparts kept in step with the English files; the license is shown in English only, its binding text.
inferences: Links to other repository files (source, status and design notes) stay on GitHub because they are the open-source project itself.
limitations: The prototype pages are generated by a throwaway script outside the repository; production renders the same sources in tools/site.
